goal: Characterize whether the tested producer can repeatedly preserve the exact H45 source while meeting the image-only and native-raster contract.

positiveControl.observation: Embedded generated product imagery is visually very close to the deterministic factual H45 recomposition and qualitatively far stronger than the later fantasy-prototype outputs.
positiveControl.correction: The prior FAIL_FACTUAL_TOPOLOGY_MISMATCH verdict is superseded because it conflated raw source pose/layout with topology. Allowed H45 reorientation must be neutralized before landmark comparison.

repeatAttempts.reason: Returned an infographic/report instead of an image-only master and embedded an obviously invented roller/slide archetype rather than the H45 factual design.
Returned another dashboard and repeated essentially the same fantasy mechanical archetype.
Returned an infographic board and again repeated the same invented product family instead of a clean source-grounded H45 master.

crossRunFinding.highAdherenceRegime: At least one earlier output is visually close to the deterministic factual recomposition and should be retained as a positive control pending landmark review.
crossRunFinding.failureRegime: Later outputs repeatedly collapse to the same obvious fantasy telescopic-slide/roller archetype.
crossRunFinding.interpretation: The main unresolved variable is reference-adherence reliability / regime switching. Cross-run similarity is only positive if it is similarity to source landmarks.

interpretation: The producer is not uniformly incapable: a much higher-adherence regime has been observed.
The producer is still not reliable enough for product use because catastrophic fantasy substitution also occurs and the image-only contract repeatedly fails.
The experiment must not use pose/layout differences as a proxy for topology when reorientation is explicitly allowed.
Future factual comparison must be pose-invariant and landmark-based.
Blind prompt repetition is no longer useful; the next experiment should isolate reference binding, edit-vs-generation mode, context contamination and output-contract effects.
stopDecision: Stop blind repetition on the current context/channel. Preserve the high-adherence output as positive control and the repeated fantasy archetype as negative control for a controlled regime-switch experiment.
nextUsefulHypothesis: Identify which producer conditions reproduce the high-adherence regime consistently before attempting viewpoint change.
